title: Figure 12: 1959 artist's rendering of a space travel control station cockpit
description: Black-and-white artist's illustration of a futuristic cockpit: a padded pilot seat facing a curved control console beneath a dark canopy. Captioned "Figure 12. Space Cockpit Visions Circa 1959. Taken directly from Seifert's 1959 book, Space Technology, this is an artist's rendering of a 'space travel control station.'" It is offered to convey the provisional nature of far-future speculation, within sections on flight-mode control, vehicle status indicators and joysticks.
